summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed for optimized image rollout. Optimized local assets are accessible and correctly referenced in header logo, founder media, and products images. Key pages render correctly and SEO/navigation/footer behavior remains intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Performance opportunity: some non-optimized external images are still used (e.g., hero/aboutField/sustainability from third-party CDNs). Converting these to local optimized assets can further improve Lighthouse consistency and reduce external dependency risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://info-showcase-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed /optimized assets return 200 and are referenced by brand logo, founder primary/gallery images, about-farmer image, and product images. Founder and products routes have no image URL failures. Footer links and route SEO metadata (title/canonical/description/og:url/structured-data) are present after asset replacement.
rca of the issue: No application regression issue reproduced in this scope. Early broken-image signal on homepage was a test-method artifact from checking lazy-loaded images before viewport exposure; URL-level validation confirms image URLs resolve correctly.
